text:
anya: quick question — our q8 bring-up for the new 30B model shows FlashAttention v3 wins on H100 latency but A100 q8 p95 is worse than v2. did anyone see this pattern before?
liam: saw similar on another model. flashv3 improves kernel throughput but q8 quant paths can expose numeric fragility on older kernels/arch.
bench-bot: summary (region/arch/kernel)
```
// short bench snapshot
us-east-1 / H100 / flashv3:  p95 38ms  throughput 420 tok/s
us-east-1 / A100 / flashv3:  p95 82ms  throughput 260 tok/s
us-east-1 / A100 / flashv2:  p95 68ms  throughput 240 tok/s
eu-west-1 / H100 / flashv3:  p95 42ms  throughput 400 tok/s
```
sam: interesting — A100 regression looks like kernel-level memory access pattern + q8 dequant overhead. did you try vendor lib fallback (cuBLAS/cuDNN) for matmul?
maria: not yet. my hypothesis: flashv3 changes tiling/kernel choice that increases L2 thrash on A100 for our sequence lengths (~512). fallback to Triton/custom vendor kernels might help.
jordyn: can we do rapid routing policy: prefer flashv3 on H100, fallback to flashv2 or vendor on A100 when p95 > 70ms for 5m window? include hysteresis to avoid flapping.
liam: +1. also test mixed-kernel for first N layers vs last layers — sometimes flashv3 helps attention-heavy tail but not mid-blocks.
maria: put together a config snippet for runtime routing, small canary rollout:
```
routing_policy:
  - match: {gpu: H100}
    kernel: flashv3
  - match: {gpu: A100}
    kernel: flashv2
  - fallback: vendor_matmul
  hysteresis_seconds: 300
  p95_threshold_ms: 70
```

anya: nice. can we also log token-level deltas and run the quality eval for q8 to make sure switching kernels doesn't change outputs? i don't want silent regressions.
liam: run eval set A/B between flashv3 vs flashv2 on quantized weights. look for n-gram diffs and embedding cosine drift. schedule: small canary (5%), collect 1k responses, then widen.
bench-bot: canary kicked off (canary id: c-1982). metrics will stream to /dashboards/kernel-routing/c-1982.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started on us-east-1 (c-1982) at 2026-03-20T15:12:03Z :rocket:
jordyn: if we see oscillation, add a cooldown policy: require >2 minute sustained breach before switching. also prefer regional defaults — eu gets H100 pool by default, us-west uses mixed.
sam: one more: check memory footprint for KV cache. flashv3 occasionally increases peak bytes which hurts packing on A100 shapes. add a KV high-water metric to routing triggers.
maria: noted. will add `kv_peak_bytes` threshold to policy and spin the canary with kv logging enabled.
anya: perfect. i'll watch the canary and start the output-diff eval. ping here with any failures. :thumbsup:
liam: thanks — if canary looks good, plan a gradual rollout with 10/30/60 then stable. watch unit cost too; flashv3 on H100 is cheaper per-token at our batch sizes.
bench-bot: canary update (5m): H100 p95 -1.8ms vs baseline, A100 p95 +12ms vs baseline for flashv3. quality diffs so far: 0.2% token edit rate increase on q8 (investigating).
anya: okay — pause widening on A100, enable v2 fallback there. continuing monitoring.
liam: filing a short ticket to track followups and quant eval results. i'll post the link when ready.
